name: pdfops-mcp
display_name: PDFops — fill, merge, split, edit, invoice PDFs
description: Deterministic PDF tools for agents: inspect AcroForm fields, fill forms, merge PDFs, generate invoices and Factur-X e-invoices, create PDFs from text, HTML or images, read text and tables, edit, watermark, protect and read or set metadata.
long_description: Gives Claude local PDF tools backed by the PDFops API (https://pdfops.dev): list a PDF's form fields with a paste-ready fill template, fill AcroForm fields (optionally flattening), merge PDFs in order, generate deterministic invoice PDFs from structured data (optionally as Factur-X e-invoices), create PDFs from Markdown, text, CSV, HTML or images, read text and tables out of PDFs (tables optionally as an Excel workbook), find text with page positions, and edit PDFs: extract, delete, rotate and split pages, add watermarks and page numbers, stamp text, images and barcodes, add form fields, embed files, unlock or password-protect, and read or set document metadata. Inputs are file paths, https URLs or data URIs; outputs are written to a path or returned inline. Works keyless (100 requests/IP/month) or with a free API key (250/month, no card).

tools.name: pdf_inspect
tools.description: List a PDF's AcroForm fields plus a paste-ready fill template

tools.name: pdf_fill

tools.name: pdf_merge
tools.description: Merge two or more PDFs in order

tools.name: pdf_invoice
tools.description: Generate a deterministic invoice PDF from structured data

tools.name: pdf_extract_pages
tools.description: Keep only the listed pages, in the order given

tools.name: pdf_delete_pages
tools.description: Remove the listed pages and keep the rest

tools.name: pdf_rotate
tools.description: Rotate pages clockwise by 90, 180, 270 or -90 degrees

tools.name: pdf_split

tools.name: pdf_watermark

tools.name: pdf_page_numbers

tools.name: pdf_unlock

tools.name: pdf_protect

tools.name: pdf_metadata

tools.name: pdf_set_metadata

tools.name: pdf_edit

tools.name: pdf_extract_text

tools.name: pdf_find_text

tools.name: pdf_text_to_pdf

tools.name: pdf_html_to_pdf

tools.name: pdf_image_to_pdf

api_key.title: PDFops API key (optional)
api_key.description: Free key from https://pdfops.dev/pricing (250 requests/month, no card). Leave empty for the keyless trial (100 requests/IP/month).

pdfops_root.title: PDF folder
pdfops_root.description: The only folder tools read from and write to (subfolders included). PDFs are read and written here; images (.png, .jpg), attachment files (.xml, .csv, .json, .txt, .md, .html, .xlsx) and .xlsx workbooks are read or written here too. Files and folders whose names start with a dot are never read. Defaults to your home folder.
